card.statement:
More involved Serre relations among $B_{i,k},B_{j,l},B_{i,k^{\prime}}$ generalizing the relations (8.8)–(8.9) are available; see [51, 67]. They can be shown to be equivalent to (8.8)–(8.9), when combined with other relations (8.3)–(8.7) above.

It is straightforward to pass the $v$ -root vectors and Drineld type presentation of $\widetilde{\textbf{U}}^{\imath}$ to ${\textbf{U}}^{\imath}$ with arbitrary parameters by central reduction. This current (or Drinfeld type) presentation will be extended beyond split types in a future work.

paper.title: Quantum symmetric pairs
paper.abstract: This is a survey of some recent progress on quantum symmetric pairs and applications. The topics include quasi K-matrices, $\imath$Schur duality, canonical bases, super Kazhdan-Lusztig theory, $\imath$Hall algebras, current presentations for affine $\imath$quantum groups, and braid group actions.
